entities.name: UniProt Q9DBL9 ABHD5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Mus musculus ABHD5; annotated as CoA-dependent lysophosphatidic acid acyltransferase, EC 2.3.1.51.
Reported substrate preference: 1-oleoyl-lysophosphatidic acid acceptor and arachidonoyl-CoA donor; also other lysophosphatidic acid and acyl-CoA species.
Annotated reaction transfers an acyl group from acyl-CoA to 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate, yielding 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate and CoA.

entities.name: ABHD5 catalytic activity
observations: This 351-aa query exactly matches mouse ABHD5; the annotated acyltransferase reaction provides phosphatidic acid, a precursor in phospholipid biosynthesis.
